activate.description: Bring enabled Brave to the foreground through CoreDevice without claiming rendered content.

open-url.description: Deliver one policy-validated HTTP or HTTPS URL directly through CoreDevice.

open-search.description: Declare the exact source-backed brave search route; the trusted adapter builds and validates its sole query field.

open-private-website.description: Declare one exact source-backed private URL route requiring explicit maintenance authorization and strict nested HTTP(S) validation.

open-ipfs.description: Declare one exact source-backed IPFS content URI after adapter validation.

open-ipns.description: Declare one exact source-backed IPNS content URI after adapter validation.

activate-direct.description: Request one direct Brave activation after addon enablement.

open-url-direct.description: Deliver one caller-supplied HTTP or HTTPS URL directly, with no prelaunch ceremony.

prohibited: sending an arbitrary brave URL or altering a reviewed custom-route host, path, field order, field names, or fixed private value
using open-text, internal deep links, shortcuts, blank-tab, bookmark, history, download, playlist, wallet, QR, Brave News, VPN promotion, or settings routes
dispatching the private website candidate or incompatible IPFS/IPNS routes through production commands
opening a private website candidate without exact authorization for its displayed destination
claiming tab ownership or automatically cleaning normal or private tabs
replaying any URL after dispatch begins or treating CoreDevice acceptance as rendering evidence
submitting forms, changing accounts, making payments, performing destructive actions, or handling protected confirmations
safety.uncertain_outcome: Brave may have received the URL, changed history, reused a tab, or created a normal or private tab before a response was lost. Inspect with the user and never replay or clean up automatically.

device: paired physical iPad with Brave installed

data_access: one explicit HTTP(S), search, private HTTP(S), IPFS, or IPNS value supplied by the caller
data_sent: the validated route to Brave and normal browser or distributed-content requests initiated by Brave
privacy.retention: The integration stores no route or tab inventory. Brave may retain history, website data, and tabs under existing settings; a private route may leave a private tab, and automatic cleanup is unsupported.
privacy.notes: Production is CoreDevice-only and remains addon-gated. Exact-profile status is separate: website and search are proven and admitted; YouTube is candidate and legacy-admitted; private website is candidate-gated; IPFS and IPNS are incompatible and production-gated.
